summary: Realistic live flashlight mode now requests hardware ray tracing by default, applies launch INI and runtime console requests, attempts ray-traced spotlight shadow intent, and logs requested versus runtime/readback RT state. Non-realistic live mode remains unchanged, and realistic mode can opt out with --disable-hardware-ray-tracing.
work_completed: Read the Scout result packet before editing and inspected the requested flashlight runtime/profile/test files.

Updated examples/flashlight/run.py so --live-lighting-mode realistic appends hardware RT INI CVars by default: r.RayTracing.Enable=1 plus Lumen hardware tracing CVars. Added --disable-hardware-ray-tracing to preserve a fallback path.
Updated runtime console-command application to request the same hardware RT CVars in realistic live mode and collect console variable readback where SPEAR's Unreal service exposes it.
Added explicit logs for hardware RT requested config, runtime command/readback state, and a caveat for unsupported RHI paths such as Vulkan SM5 rejecting or ignoring RT requests.
Updated examples/flashlight/flashlight_profiles.py with robust reflected method/property probing to set ray-traced spotlight shadow intent when hardware RT and flashlight shadows are requested.
Added focused unit coverage for CLI defaults/disable behavior, config string composition, runtime command/readback state, and spotlight ray-traced shadow intent.
Validation run: python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation passed 84 tests.
Validation run: python -m py_compile examples/flashlight/run.py examples/flashlight/flashlight_profiles.py tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py passed.

findings.message: User run command with hardware RT requested by default: conda activate spear-env && python examples/flashlight/run.py --map cafeteria_500sqft_v2 --live-lighting-mode realistic --flashlight-profile realistic_live_flashlight --scene-light-intensity-scale 0.0005 --movement-speed 600 --disable-auto-exposure --startup-warmup-seconds 3

Fallback command if the package/RHI rejects hardware RT: conda activate spear-env && python examples/flashlight/run.py --map cafeteria_500sqft_v2 --live-lighting-mode realistic --flashlight-profile realistic_live_flashlight --scene-light-intensity-scale 0.0005 --movement-speed 600 --disable-auto-exposure --startup-warmup-seconds 3 --disable-hardware-ray-tracing

This change requests and logs hardware RT state but does not prove the local packaged simulator/RHI supports it. The next live run should check the new hardware RT runtime/readback log and Unreal startup logs for rejected or ignored CVars.

follow_up_recommendations: Have Reviewer inspect the reflected ray-traced shadow property/method name coverage and the chosen Lumen hardware RT CVars before runtime validation.
During the next manual simulator run, verify that the logged hardware RT readback has confirmed=true and that Unreal logs do not report SM5/Vulkan ray tracing disabled.
memory_worthy: Realistic live flashlight mode now requests hardware ray tracing by default via launch INI and runtime console commands, with --disable-hardware-ray-tracing as an opt-out.
Flashlight live mode now logs hardware RT requested settings separately from runtime command/readback state and attempts ray-traced spotlight shadow intent when hardware RT is requested.
